items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Miles Davis was playing it -- [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Well I practiced for awhile, then I had to have some work done on my teeth. And that's what kept me away from the horn. And by the time my mouth got well enough for me to play, and I looked at myself in the mirror with this horn -- and you couldn't see me for the horn -- I thought I'd try to find something a little smaller. And, of course, the flügel horn was coming in to popularity by some of the reed man, so I decided I'd get a flügel horn.
